title: A bare request value becomes equality, a helper is used as authored, and nothing is repaired.
why: behavioural spec 'request': 'method', 'path' and 'body' are compiled by the 'literal' rules and are otherwise untouched — the method is not upper-cased and the path is not normalised, because repairing a value is the engine's call to reject, not the SDK's to make (SDK spec §2.1).
